{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for MISO with a 180-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. The study will use only admissible decision-time variables and will not modify raw data. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "Region MISO, horizon 180 minutes, and shortfall cost 10.0 are supported. The operator explicitly requests no raw curve modification, which aligns with the forbidden raw_data_modification rule. The study uses the standard rolling design and requires human approval.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "confirm_no_raw_data_modification_and_no_future_information",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_step_days_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "produce_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_finalization"
  ]
}
